title: DECISION: signing key required for non-loopback listeners
description: main.rs refuses to start when the transit daemon listens on a non-loopback address but operator.signing_key_path is not set. An ephemeral key generated at startup means article signatures change on every restart, breaking X-Stoa-Sig verification for peers that cached the operator's public key. The check permits loopback-only deployments (dev mode) to use an ephemeral key with a warn-level log, while preventing the silent correctness problem in production deployments.
